nodes.name: Every 15m
nodes.notes: ADR-066 Block 4: 'handed-off-but-not-finished' reconciliation dead-man's switch. Every 15 min, calls public.check_stuck_waiter_sessions() — any waiter_sessions row still handed_off/running past config.session_waiter.stuck_after_minutes (default 50m, above the ~45m absolute budget so a healthy long task does not false-alarm). A stuck row means the session-waiter died/wedged AFTER taking the session, which the reactive Error Handler cannot catch. CRITICAL so the orphaned session is recovered. Active now; the table is empty until Block-5 handoffs populate it, so this stays silent until then, then immediately catches the first handed-off-but-not-finished session.

nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Test entry for DoD verification via scripts/test-subworkflow.mjs. No inputs needed.

nodes.name: Check Stuck Sessions
nodes.notes: Calls the SECURITY DEFINER getter public.check_stuck_waiter_sessions() (migration 049). Returns one row {stuck_count, details}; stuck = handed_off/running past config.session_waiter.stuck_after_minutes. NO onError: a DB failure throws -> global Error Handler CRITICAL (a monitor that can't read its own signal must be LOUD, not fail silent).

nodes.name: Alert Stuck Sessions
nodes.notes: CRITICAL via Post Alert (v1) when one or more sessions were handed to the waiter but never finished. Recover via the reconciliation cron / manually: the agent session may still be queryable on Anthropic's side (GET /v1/sessions/{id}/events).
